basic_details.job_title: NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Anaesthetist, Paediatrician and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Anaesthetist, Ophthalmic Surgeon, Paediatrician, Orthopaedic Surgeon, General Surgeon
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

qualification.details: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma in respective subject MS/MD/DNB from an institute recognized by NMC/MCI as per prevailing norms. Registration with the National Medical Council (NMC) or a State Medical Council (SMC). All qualifications (Master / Degree / Diploma) must come from a university or college recognised by the Govt. of India. | Candidates with experience may be preferred. Knowledge of the local language. | Anyone previously terminated from a Government organisation will not be considered. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

selection_process: and only eligible candidates are called for an interview. An application that does not follow the prescribed format or meet the required criteria will be rejected without any reason given. The Administration reserves the right to end the selection process.
how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from www.ddd.gov.in. The form is also printed on pages 2 and 3 of the notification.
Fill in the post applied for, your personal details, category (SC / ST / OBC / Others), languages known, marital status and your age as on 14.11.2026.
Enter your education details (S.S.C., H.S.C., MBBS, Diploma, Post Graduation), your work experience and your NMC/SMC registration details.
Paste a recent passport-size photograph (3.5 cm x 4.5 cm). Tick "x" on any item that does not apply to the post, then sign the declaration. Unsigned applications will be rejected.

Send the form and documents by post to: Member Secretary (GB), Rogi Kalyan Samiti, Govt. Hospital, Daman Office of the Medical Superintendent, NAMO. Hospital, Daman, Nani Daman - 396210. You can also email them to [email protected].
Make sure the application arrives by 12:30 PM on 14 November 2026.
Experience certificates from the organisations or institutions you worked for

content_sections.heading: About NAMO Hospital Daman
content_sections.text: NAMO Hospital is a government hospital in Daman (PIN 396 210). It comes under the Office of the Medical Superintendent, Department of Health & Family Welfare, U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. Applications go to the Member Secretary (GB) of the Rogi Kalyan Samiti, Govt. Hospital, Daman.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened first, and only eligible candidates are called for an interview. An application that does not follow the prescribed format or meet the required criteria will be rejected without any reason given. The Administration reserves the right to end the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are filled on a short-term contract basis, and the place of work is NAMO Hospital, Daman. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts does NAMO Hospital Daman have for Anaesthetists?
faq.answer: There are 02 Anaesthetist posts. Ophthalmic Surgeon and Paediatrician also have 02 posts each, and Orthopaedic Surgeon and General Surgeon have 01 each.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply with a PG Diploma instead of an MD/MS?
faq.answer: Yes. The essential qualification is MBBS with a PG Degree or Diploma (MS/MD/DNB) in the subject. A fresh Diploma holder gets a gross Rs. 1,15,000 a month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the highest salary on offer?
faq.answer: A Degree holder with 5 years of experience gets Rs. 2,00,000 a month: Rs. 1,75,000 basis plus Rs. 25,000 incentive.

faq.question: Q4. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled on a short-term contract basis at NAMO Hospital, Daman.

faq.question: Q5. Can I send my application by email?
faq.answer: Yes. Besides posting it to the Rogi Kalyan Samiti in Nani Daman, you can email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Which registration is needed?
faq.answer: You must be registered with the National Medical Council (NMC) or a State Medical Council (SMC). Attach a self-attested copy of the registration certificate.

faq.question: Q7. Will every applicant be called for the interview?
faq.answer: No. Only eligible candidates are called. Applications that do not follow the prescribed format are rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply?
faq.answer: Anyone previously terminated from a Government organisation will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. What date is used to calculate age in the form?
faq.answer: The application form asks for your age in years, months and days as on 14.11.2026.
